title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：mountain　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mountain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the farmer ① climbed the mountain that no child in the field would have noted, and he said the climbing was the whole of the autumn. The ② mountain, meaning the peak itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unnoted in the book; a mountain, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ mountain in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ mountain at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mountain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the farmer said the noting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mountain was the whole of the matter, meaning the barrier and not the peak. The ⑥ mountain, meaning the barrier and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; mountain, he said, is either something you climb or the only word that means both a peak and a barrier. He said the barrier is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ mountain had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ mountain of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of noting; mountain, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mountain I remember is the peak noted in the almanac, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ mountain, my mother said in 2002, is the only peak that improves by being noted; every mountain, she said, is a barrier that has agreed to look like a peak. She said the barrier was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 山；高山（指田垄里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 山；高山（指那座山本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：climb the mountain 登这一座山
D. n. 山；高山（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 山之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的山之事）
F. n. 山；高山（指农事历里写到、被记下的那一座）
G. n. 山、阻隔（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 阻隔（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: climbed the mountain that no child in the field would have noted
The mountain, meaning the peak itself and not the basket
the mountain at the far fence

answers.why: climb the mountain 意为“登这一座山”，1993 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记下的一座山做了一遍。
mountain 意为“山；高山”，指那座山本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记下。
mountain 意为“山；高山”，指田垄里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
mountain 意为“山；高山”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mountain 意为“山、阻隔”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座阻隔就是那件事的全部。
mountain 意为“阻隔”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座山，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mountain 意为“山；高山”，指农事历里写到、被记下的那一座，到 1998 年这一座成了农事历里的一行。
mountain 意为“山之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的山之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记下。
mountain 意为“山；高山”，我记得的是农事历里记下过的那一座，2000 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一座。
mountain 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，山是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的山。
